note: Honest coverage frontier. status: present = a runnable step drives real code and passes (must name a test); pending = specified behavior whose implementation does not exist yet; retrospective_gap = shipped without a driving test (must be zero for governed behavior, INV-22). Phase 1 (T-023-1..7) landed: the seam, the deterministic attributor, the rules-as-data mapping, the PVE reader, the runner wiring, the persistence, and the security routing. The embedded default ruleset is GENERIC (taxonomy->disposition mapping only); site principals + pool carve-outs are supplied by a deploy-time override (TG_ATTRIBUTION_CONFIG) and are never baked into the binary. REQ-2304 dominance is per-record: a positively-unsanctioned actor co-occurring with a sanctioned/self/carve-out record still resolves attributed-suspicious (a carve-out can never mask an intruder into authorized-test). Persistence covers the taxonomy outcome + minimized evidence on session_triage; the matched rule id and candidate set are not separately columned in Phase 1 (a Phase-2 refinement). Phase-2 items (the covered-trail-no-entry disposition, the tracer named step, the journal/k8s/netbox/awx/gitops/docker readers, the expires_at retention job) remain pending.

scenarios.name: A covered audit trail missing an entry for an observed mutation escalates as suspicious
scenarios.test: core/attribution/coverage_empty_test.go::TestCoveredEmptyOnObservedMutationEscalatesSuspicious (covered + answered + zero-actor + observed-mutation ⇒ attributed-suspicious) + ::TestMutationFlagIsWhatDiscriminates (the observed-mutation flag is the SOLE discriminator — byte-identical covered-but-empty inputs resolve observe-only vs suspicious) + the three non-escalation guards ::TestObservedMutationWithActorResolvesOnActorNotEmptiness, ::TestFailedReaderNeverSuspiciousEvenWithObservedMutation, ::TestUncoveredSubjectNeverSuspiciousEvenWithObservedMutation + the observe-only floor ::TestCoveredButEmptyIsSurfacedNotEscalated, ::TestCommonNoActorFaultDoesNotFlood (no mutation ⇒ no flood). The attributed-suspicious → security-escalate → POLL_PAUSE + security_escalation routing it rides is already proven by TestDispositionForResolution (REQ-2304 half 1).
scenarios.note: TG-407 DELIVERED (classifier mechanism). REQ-2304 half 2 was UNIMPLEMENTABLE as originally shaped — Evidence.Covered rode on the evidence ROWS, so a reader that affirmatively covers the target and finds NOTHING had no row to carry the flag. Now: a reader emits a CoverageMarker (Covered=true, empty Actor) on a clean answered miss (modules/actorevidence pve/journal/awx/netbox); Attribute holds the marker aside (never an actor) and sets coveredSubject; AttributeObserving escalates covered-but-empty to attributed-suspicious IFF the session carries a confirmed OBSERVED MUTATION (Observation.MutationObserved). The predicate is (a) an affirmative coverage marker for the subject, (b) the reader ANSWERED — a failed read emits no marker and is never suspicious (REQ-2307), (c) ZERO admissible actor entries, (d) obs.MutationObserved. The observed-mutation gate is the ingredient the first-cut review (de3bbb19) named as missing: without it, covered-but-empty is the COMMON no-actor fault (a crash) and escalating it floods SECURITY and neuters auto-heal — measured live 2026-08-07, of 3,383 sessions 1,773 carry no evidence, most covered-but-empty. LIVE-ARMING FOLLOW-UP: the estate does not yet emit a positive observed-mutation signal (only a recovery-transition label exists; no config/resource-hash diff is computed), and deriving one from alert-name heuristics would be the exact spurious-suspicion source INV-09 warns against — so the production call site (temporal/runner AttributeActivity) keeps the safe observe-only default (Observation{}, MutationObserved=false) and attributed-suspicious stays 0 live until a positive observed-mutation source is wired. The classifier behavior THIS scenario asserts is implemented and unit-proven; wiring the source is the remaining live step.

scenarios.name: Persisted evidence is retention-bounded and redacted at every boundary
scenarios.test: core/attribution/minimized_fields_test.go: TestEvidenceCarriesOnlyTheMinimizedFields (REQ-2313 structurally — the type has NOWHERE to put a raw log line; killing mutation executed: adding a RawLine field reds it) + modules/actorevidence/tool/tool_test.go: TestHostileEvidenceCannotForgeStructure / TestEvidenceIsRenderedWithACiteableID (the seed-facing rendering is delimited and citeable, and hostile field content cannot forge it) + core/db/agent_step_evidence_reap_test.go: TestEvidenceReaperDeletesOnlyRowsPastRetention / TestEvidenceReaperRefusesACutoffInsideTheFloor / TestOnlyTheSecurityDefinerPathCanDeleteEvidence (the RAW evidence this is derived from is TTL-bounded through a SECURITY DEFINER path; the derived minimized record lives on the audit spine, which migration 0055's header states is preserved by archival rather than TTL — the spine/body split, INV-14)
scenarios.note: PENDING WORK, not a missing oracle — and only ONE of its three assertions is missing. Measured 2026-08-07: (a) 'seed-rendered evidence is delimited as data and input-screened' EXISTS — screen.Scrub runs before the agent_step write (temporal/runner/activities.go:743,752) and screen.IsJailbreak guards the proposal surface; (b) secret-shaped material is MEASURED — core/db/agent_step_evidence_shape.go and governance_ledger_shape.go publish SecretShaped counts (TG-345) — though a counter is monitoring, not redaction; (c) 'the record carries a retention bound' does NOT exist: there is no expires_at column on any actor-evidence migration and no ExpiresAt field in core/attribution or core/db. So the scenario cannot pass until the retention bound is built, and the honest split is roughly two-thirds present.
